<reason>CON won the central enforcement clash. PRO argued permission proliferates recipes and camouflage, but CON showed PRO's own detection model - grants, publications, whistleblowers, screened orders - depends on legal visibility the ban would extinguish, distinguished the BWC as banning non-defensive weapons, and separated publication control from research ban. PRO never resolved that contradiction and ignored corrections on pandemic frequency while overplaying the no-vaccine concession that CON answered as portfolio value.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's Rebuttal 2 turn that PRO wants to catch cheaters by destroying the surveillance network that catches cheaters, plus frozen-definition point that the line would rely on knowledge the ban forbids updating.</best_rebuttal>
